meta.description:

In this video, I take you inside my stay at The Pearl Hoi An in Hoi An, Vietnam. You'll see the Superior King Garden View room, breakfast buffet, swimming pools, beach access, hotel facilities, and my overall experience staying at this beachfront resort.

Located next to An Bang Beach, The Pearl Hoi An offers a relaxing resort atmosphere while still being within easy reach of Hoi An Ancient Town. During my stay, I show the room, pools, breakfast, and the resort grounds so you can get a realistic look at what to expect before booking.

📍 Hotel: The Pearl Hoi An
📍 Location: An Bang Beach, Hoi An, Vietnam
🛏️ Room: Superior King Garden View
🍳 Breakfast Included
📶 Free WiFi
🏖️ Beach Access
🏊 Swimming Pools

🚌 Free shuttle bus to Hoi An Old Town (book at reception, max 15 seats): resort → town 14:00, 15:00, 16:00 · town → resort 14:30, 15:30, 18:00.

Have you stayed at The Pearl Hoi An? Let me know your experience in the comments.

Thanks for watching and please subscribe for more hotel reviews, travel videos, and Vietnam travel content.
